messages.subject: Orderby="Integer" in Rhipe MapReduce (updated)
parts:
Hello,

I'm new to R and Rhipe ... so please excuse my ignorance here. Trying
to learn a couple new things at once and its slow going. I'm having
trouble ordering a list of integers in a data.frame. Just so we can
have common frame of reference, I've put my question below in terms
of the Arline Dataset example contained with the 65.2 Documentation.
I want to get a result set back that is ordered by the 'dist' column.
Here is the original script:

setup <- expression({
convertHHMM <- function(s){
t(sapply(s,function(r){
l=nchar(r)
if(l==4) c(substr(r,1,2),substr(r,3,4))
else if(l==3) c(substr(r,1,1),substr(r,2,3))
else c('0','0')
})
)}
})
map <- expression({
y <- do.call("rbind",lapply(map.values,function(r){
if(substr(r,1,4)!='Year') strsplit(r,",")[[1]]
}))
mu <- rep(1,nrow(y));yr <- y[,1]; mn=y[,2];dy=y[,3]
hr <- convertHHMM(y[,5])
depart <- ISOdatetime(year=yr,month=mn,day=dy,hour=hr[,1],min=hr[,
2],sec=mu)
hr <- convertHHMM(y[,6])
sdepart <- ISOdatetime(year=yr,month=mn,day=dy,hour=hr[,1],min=hr[,
2],sec=mu)
hr <- convertHHMM(y[,7])
arrive <- ISOdatetime(year=yr,month=mn,day=dy,hour=hr[,1],min=hr[,
2],sec=mu)
hr <- convertHHMM(y[,8])
sarrive <- ISOdatetime(year=yr,month=mn,day=dy,hour=hr[,1],min=hr[,
2],sec=mu)
d <- data.frame(depart= depart,sdepart = sdepart
,arrive = arrive,sarrive =sarrive
,carrier = y[,9],origin = y[,17]
,dest=y[,18],dist = y[,19], year=yr, month-mn, day=dy
,cancelled=y[,22], stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
d <- d[order(d$sdepart),]
rhcollect(d[c(1,nrow(d)),"sdepart"],d)
})
reduce <- expression(
reduce = {
lapply(reduce.values,function(i)
rhcollect(reduce.key,i))}
)
mapred <- list(rhipe_map_buff_size=5000)
z <- rhmr(map=map,reduce=reduce,setup=setup,inout=c("text","sequence")
,ifolder="/airline/data/",ofolder="/airline/
blocks",mapred=mapred,orderby="numeric")
rhex(z)

I made the following mods to three lines of that MapReduce job based
on my research for ordering by the distance traveled ("dist" field):

d <- d[order(d$dist),]

rhcollect(d[c(1,nrow(d)),"dist"],d)

z <-
rhmr(map=map,reduce=reduce,setup=setup,inout=c("text","sequence")
,ifolder="/airline/data/",ofolder="/airline/
blocks",mapred=mapred,orderby="integer")

However, this doesn't work. The dataset I get back isn't ordered by
"dist" in ascending or descending order. Notice that there are quotes
around every field, to include all values in the 'dist' column. That
indicates to me that R interprets each entry in the data.frame as a
string. Perhaps that's why it's not sorting appropriately? Would
greatly appreciate any help.

Thanks in advance,
Jeremy

messages.subject: Re: Orderby="Integer" in Rhipe MapReduce (updated)
parts:
I must confess I don't know where your error is at, but I commonly use
a strategy for getting these things right.

At the local R I do:
ifolder = "/airline/data"
idata = rhread(ifolder, type=type,max=max) #fill in type and max
map.keys = lapply(idata,function(kv) k[[1]])
map.values = lapply(idata,function(kv) k[[2]])

And then test my manipulations. From there I paste it all into the
appropriate pieces of the MapReduce expressions.
